gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-hanuman: Letters strung out like beads on a long thread give Bruno Ace SC its look. And the heading earns its keep big and short, while Hanuman, a refined text serif, sits high-waisted below.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-kadwa: Bruno Ace SC strings its letters like beads on a thread, no thinning anywhere. Kadwa, a serif with open-ended curves and an oversized x-height, brings editorial warmth beneath the heading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noticia-text: Spaced like beads on a thread, Bruno Ace SC has no tapering. Give it generous size up top and let Noticia Text, a literary serif with deep curve entrances, stay modest underneath.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-piazzolla: Bruno Ace SC spreads its letters like beads on a long thread, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Piazzolla, the classic serif beneath, brings authority through lowercase nearly matching capitals.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-pridi: Bruno Ace SC strings its letters like beads on a thread. Pridi, the classic serif, would read warmly page after page, its proud lowercase leaving generous room at curve ends.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-scope-one: Expressive and distinctive, Bruno Ace SC spreads its letters like beads on a long thread, with almost no stroke contrast. Bruno shows off; Scope One, the classic serif, does the reading.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-fs-paquito: Chunky pipe-cleaner strokes, pressed flat, give Cabin Sketch a bold, distinctive look. Paquito, a confident serif with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, feels approachable and suits brief bursts of reading.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-fs-asap: Friendly and graceful, Calligraffitti looks traced in marker, its towering midzone full of open space. And Asap steps in with readable, near-capital lowercase, making a few lines of text go down smoothly.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-fs-familjen-grotes: Strokes that look traced with a marker, plus a towering midzone, give Calligraffitti a friendly, graceful hand. Familjen Grotesk supplies the lively counterpoint, its bowls left unfinished on one side.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-fs-fira-sans: Marker-traced and tall-waisted, Calligraffitti brings friendly curves and spill-out counters. Fira Sans then supplies the strongest counterweight, its uniform strokes and larger x-height suiting brief bursts of reading.
